address: Mei Ling Market & Food Centre, #02-15, 159 Mei Chin Road, 140159, Singapore
bio: Cantonese-style noodles topped with beef brisket, pork ribs, pork knuckles or beef tendon are the name of the game here. The noodles are springy, and the pork knuckles are braised until gelatinous in a secret soy sauce....
